label: run100b committed ramp
definition: Run 100b: MEASURED PROBE (mid-CF-band shape, Option B) - committed-ramp-spread 0.15 on the run-97a keeper base. Renders each plant's committed band as a 6-slice rising ramp spanning committed_mult x (1 +/- 0.15) instead of a flat block, so the plant clears committed capacity progressively (smears the 0->committed-share snap that lands CC at the 0.45 plateau). Mean committed bid unchanged -> class volume ~preserved; targets the lower half of the 0.3-0.7 CF-band hole. Pairs with 100a.
